title: Text: DET Michele Wysocki ↔ Anthony Fenech

content.text: You should talk to Al more, he likes you
Yeah, I asked him what he thought of his PR staff at dinner last night
And he said he only talks to you and Chad and Ron
I offered him thoughts, but it made me think that while others are sucking up to Ron, you should keep building your relationship with Al.
I definitely appreciate the heads up. Being more assertive is something I'm working on. That's great advice.
I just think if Al becomes invested in you on a personal level, he'll look out for you and it will pay off
Yeah, absolutely. I appreciate you looking out.
Not interested in this shit show 😂😂
I've been on the phone with my girlfriend, this is terrible
In my car charging my phone
Yeah, she just had a rough day at work and needs to talk
